recommendations: See [the resolution handoff](RESOLUTION_HANDOFF.md) for the six-factor criterion, Tóth split, exceptional Fermat reduction and the global B3 cap.

frontier.audited_claim: N > 10^300 (> 10^740 on all I=ℓt² a>1; > 10^17240 if i=p^j; > 10^3136 if 6th-power-free)
ω(N) ≥ 6 (≥ 8 if 3 ∤ N or i=p^(2u); ≥ 443 if 6th-power-free)
Ω(N) ≥ 37. Every candidate has an index with Ω(i_p)+5 ≤ Ω(N). Sixth-power-free gives Ω(N) ≥ 1179.
21ω ≤ 8Ω+39. At 3∤N, 8ω+4L₂ ≤ 3Ω+7. In the sixth-power-free case more than one sixth of the support is an exact-square prime ≡1 mod 5.
frontier.staged_claim: Extend Clayton–Hansen and Zelinsky slopes across uncovered residue classes

frontier.audited_claim: i_q ≥ 2379. At a>1, I=ℓt² forces N > 10^740 and excludes q ≡ 2,4 mod 7.
frontier.staged_claim: Full closure of I = ℓ t² (Hirakawa 2024)
Unconditional elimination of i = p^(2u) via higher p-adic congruences
